title: City
html:
The City building increases a nation's population capacity/limit. Every city adds 25,000 to the maximum population.[1]

Details

The first city costs 125,000 gold, 250,000 for the second, 500,000 for the third, and then 1,000,000 gold for every city after that.[2]

Like other buildings, cities can be captured by other nations when a nation annexes the land the city is on.

Strategy

  • A commonly used strategy is to build cities near an expanding bot. While the bot is capturing your cities, you can continue building them for 125k gold, at least if you don't have any other cities elsewhere. When you're ready, you can retake the land and overall spend a fraction of the gold.
    However, this strategy isn’t easy to execute and often requires a corner spot on the map due to the ability of other players to attack the bot you're messing with.
